en.gameDesc: Classify languages in the Chomsky hierarchy, test closure properties of language classes, and answer decidability questions about Turing machines.

af.gameDesc: Klassifiseer tale in die Chomsky-hiërargie, toets sluitingseienskappe van taalklasse, en beantwoord beslisbaarheidsvrae oor Turing-masjiene.

zu.gameDesc: Hlukanisa izilimi ku-Chomsky hierarchy, hlola izakhiwo zokuvala zamaqoqo ezilimi, uphendule imibuzo yokunqunywa ngama-Turing machines.
